decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is core capital equipment with substantial in-house development behind it, so management persists with it and treats weak sales as a normal ramp-up.

The numbering module was publicly announced as part of the software portfolio and directly serves the declared serialization and traceability direction, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated strategy.
CodeScan was presented on its own page as the expanded successor to PharmaScan and supports the firm's traceability and digitalization narrative, so the firm keeps this low-cost app.
Inline code verification is central to end-to-end traceability and compliance offerings, so management keeps investing in it and attributes any weak results to temporary market factors.
The layout design software was showcased on the home page and underpins common operation across systems, making it a visible commitment that management will defend.
